commands: mkdir -p dist/packages/nx && cp packages/nx/*.md packages/nx/executors.json packages/nx/package.json dist/packages/nx/

mkdir -p packages/nx/dist && for d in executors generators; do find "packages/nx/src/$d" \( -name 'schema.json' -o -name 'schema.d.ts' \) 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do rel="${f#packages/nx/src/}"; mkdir -p "packages/nx/dist/$(dirname "$rel")"; cp "$f" "packages/nx/dist/$rel"; done; done
mkdir -p dist/packages/nx/dist/base && cp packages/nx/src/base/*.schema.json packages/nx/src/base/*.schema.d.ts dist/packages/nx/dist/base/

mkdir -p dist/packages/nx/docs/api && find packages/nx/src -name '*.md' | while read -r f; do rel="${f#packages/nx/src/}"; mkdir -p "dist/packages/nx/docs/api/$(dirname "$rel")"; cp "$f" "dist/packages/nx/docs/api/$rel"; done
